text:
maria: Heads-up: I ran a weekend sim for cost-aware compaction. Goal was to cut fragmentation ~15% while keeping tail latency stable. TL;DR: ~12% cost drop, 90th +8ms, 99th +40ms. Thoughts?

kevin: Nice. Which compaction trigger did you test — utilization threshold or periodic sweep?

maria: threshold=0.65 bin utilization, aggressive compaction window=2h for idle nodes. Sim config snippet: 
```json
{"trigger":"util<0.65","batch_size":4,"cooldown":7200}
```

jamal: Concern: APAC nodes have higher network egress and longer pre-warm latency — moving pods between racks/regions will blow up the 99th. Did you model region-aware pinning?

maria: yes — we enforced region_pin=true for ~40% of tenants; those tenants only saw ~3% fragmentation improvement. Biggest wins were on dev/batch-only seats.

olivia: Ops note: NSX flow limits in us-west cause slow reassigns if >20 pods move simultaneously. We should cap concurrent compactions per rack. @infra-bot can you share the reorder logs from the sim?

infra-bot: Sim run 1765001234 finished. Key metrics: total_gpu_hours_saved: 184, latency_90:+8ms, latency_99:+40ms, prewarm_fail_rate:+0.7%. Artifacts: s3://redwood-sims/1765001234/

kevin: If we cap concurrent compactions to 8 per rack, what does savings look like?

maria: Prelim re-run with cap=8: savings drop to ~120 GPU-hours/week, tail latencies return near baseline. I think trading ~35% of savings for SLO stability is acceptable.

jamal: :thinking_face: Another approach: label tenants by priority and do "no-migrate" relaxed compaction for gold customers, aggressive for bronze. Can scheduler encode that?

olivia: Yes — scheduler supports tenant labels/affinities. We'll need a rollout plan + dashboards. Recommend 48h canary on staging then a small us-west roll.

maria: Proposed rollout plan:
1) implement rack-concurrency cap=8
2) implement tenant-priority flags (no-migrate for gold)
3) add cost-threshold gating (only run compaction if projected savings > threshold)
4) 48h staging canary -> us-west small -> global

kevin: :thumbsup: Add a cost threshold alert so compaction only triggers if projected savings > X GPU-hours/week.

maria: Proposed threshold = 100 GPU-hours/week. Anyone object?

jamal: No objections. Add extra tracing: pre/post packing mapping and trace ids so we can rollback if regressions show up.

olivia: I'll add dashboard panels: per-rack move rate, prewarm failure rate, tail-latency by tenant-priority, and a cost-savings forecast panel.

infra-bot: Created issue INFRA-4271: "Cost-aware compaction rollout" with checklist, artifacts, and canary tasks.

maria: Thanks all. I'll draft the RFC and attach sim artifacts + config. Closing thread for now — ping me if you want early access to logs or want to be on the canary list.
